observation: The inscription sits above and to the left of a band of repeated transverse wavy strokes descending/curving into the green lower region. It is not inside a clearly bounded mouth of one drawn pipe. No explicit directional arrowhead or label leader is visible. A drawn extended stream/band is a more literal description than a single mouth or port.
flow_direction: Downward-looking layout, but not independently keyed; substance not identified
meaning_consequence: Compare stream/emission C0 with opening and deictic C0; do not export sy as plural or reversal
